summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony's product launch by analyzing confidential supplier/ERP data and building a general recheck-and-act agent product (poller, extraction, recompute, supplier emails with approval) with a demo and a 12:00 Sunday hand-in.
summary.outcome: Found that Soony's plan hid real Collector's/Standard shortfalls (80,000 vs 8,000 art book receipt, failed statue lot, clear cases at port, card shortfall). Built and pushed a working app (Today/Launch/routines/approval loop) on branch jonas/today-flow with 317 tests passing; README, demo script, video and pitch remain for the hand-in.

repo: Confidential portal data lives in gitignored data/ (raw, drops, notes, img); .env holds SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN and is gitignored while .env.example is committed.

Portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip); no webhooks or notifications. Files change without warning and get replaced under the same name, so polling with SHA-256 comparison is the only way to detect drops.

Team workflow is in CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md (claim tasks with a 'Now' line); work happens on branch jonas/today-flow; Entire hooks checkpoint sessions only when repo files change and push checkpoints with git push.
Backend is Python (src/ask_soony, pytest, ruff) and frontend is web/ (React/TS, Vite build); the server must be restarted after backend changes even though web/dist is rebuilt.
Prepared routine proposals can go stale when their case is decided elsewhere; they must expire on case decision and be deduped across routines.
Push notifications go to every subscribed device; there is no per-person routing, and ASK_TEAMS_WEBHOOK is empty in .env so Teams delivery doesn't work.
ASK_SIGNOFF_SIMULATE=<seconds> enables a simulated auto-approval by the approver, labelled 'simulated for the demo'; it is off by default.

code.finding: Routine diagram was reworked into n8n-style node cards (When / one 'Only if' node with numbered conditions and funnel / one node per Then step) on a dotted canvas.
New sign-off module: one-time token links to /ok/<token>, push/Teams delivery, approve/decline, runs at most once per link, simulation timer.
Lets valid /ok and count-page token links through without the dashboard password.

Left case list fixes: expandable '+N more', auto-open for selected case, sticky self-scrolling column; no 'Needs you' row marked selected while a decided case is open (this caused the scroll jump); 'Ready for your OK' group per routine.

friction: Portal token was empty at first, blocking data access (401) until the user provided it.
Scanned PDFs and Polish/Korean/Chinese documents needed rendering to images and translation to be read.
A routine silently failed because option matching searched for the literal 'make po,rev'; the 'seen' marker then prevented retries.
Prepared steps shown in the UI were stale and failed with 'not an open card' when the user pressed Do all 4.
Internal messages and escalations were only recorded, yet the UI claimed 'DC site lead has it now', which was false.
PackRight received two extra rev C requests after already answering that it needed the PDF and change notice first.
An outbox lost-update race lost a recorded approval and had to be restored from the Sent folder.
Teams webhook unavailable and an email to an assumed address bounced because the address didn't exist.
Launch wording implied the user had to decide when the case was waiting on Maren.
